# Claude Code Commands

> Unofficial, plain-language guide to all 115 Claude Code slash commands, in 7 languages. For each command: what it does, its best use, and safety notes. Checked against the official commands reference (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/commands) on 2026-11-07; where they differ, the official docs win.

## Pages

- [English](https://futurevolab.github.io/claude-code-commands-i18n/): All 115 Claude Code Slash Commands, Explained in Plain English
- [日本語](https://futurevolab.github.io/claude-code-commands-i18n/ja/): Claude Code スラッシュコマンド一覧｜全115コマンドをやさしい日本語で解説
- [简体中文](https://futurevolab.github.io/claude-code-commands-i18n/zh-cn/): Claude Code 斜杠命令大全｜全部 115 个命令中文详解与最佳用法
- [繁體中文](https://futurevolab.github.io/claude-code-commands-i18n/zh-hant/): Claude Code 斜線指令大全｜全部 115 個指令中文說明與最佳用法
- [한국어](https://futurevolab.github.io/claude-code-commands-i18n/ko/): Claude Code 슬래시 명령어 총정리 | 115개 명령어를 쉬운 한국어로
- [Русский](https://futurevolab.github.io/claude-code-commands-i18n/ru/): Команды Claude Code: полный список слэш-команд (115) простым языком
- [Español](https://futurevolab.github.io/claude-code-commands-i18n/es/): Comandos de Claude Code: lista completa de los 115 comandos de barra
